summary: Iteration 59 - CSV Equipment Import Testing for Pulse Site Onboarding Wizard. Frontend: 100% pass rate. All CSV import features working correctly including Template download, CSV parsing, error handling, and full wizard flow with imported equipment.

issues: Console warning: Missing Description or aria-describedby for DialogContent - accessibility improvement needed (existing issue from previous iterations)

Template button visibility.details: Template button (data-testid='onboard-csv-template') visible in Step 3 Equipment

Import CSV button visibility.details: Import CSV button (data-testid='onboard-csv-import') visible in Step 3 Equipment

Add Machine button visibility.details: Add Machine button (data-testid='onboard-add-equipment') visible in Step 3 Equipment

Template download.details: Clicking Template button downloads 'pulse_equipment_template.csv' with correct headers (Name, Type, Manufacturer, Serial Number, Location) and 3 example rows

CSV import - valid file.details: Uploading valid CSV populates equipment rows correctly. Tested with 3 rows: Treadmill X1, Bike Pro, Lat Pulldown Elite - all imported with correct Name, Type, Manufacturer, Serial Number, Location

CSV import - empty file.details: Uploading CSV with only headers shows error toast 'No valid equipment rows found' and adds no equipment

CSV import - missing required fields.details: CSV rows with missing Name or Type are skipped. Only valid rows are imported (tested with 3 rows, 2 invalid, 1 valid - only 1 imported)

CSV import - quoted fields.details: CSV with quoted fields parsed correctly. Commas inside quotes preserved ('Treadmill, Model X'), quotes inside quotes handled ('Bike Pro Edition')

Equipment rows editable.details: Imported equipment rows display as editable cards with Name, Type, Manufacturer, Serial Number, Location input fields

Equipment remove button.details: Remove button (data-testid='onboard-remove-equip-{i}') works correctly - removes equipment row from form

Review step shows imported equipment.details: Step 4 Review displays imported equipment with name, type, and serial number

Full wizard flow with CSV import.details: Complete flow: Step 1 (site name) > Step 2 (owner) > Step 3 (CSV import) > Step 4 (review) > Create site > Success screen with company code 992AE22C

Backend integration.details: POST /api/master-admin/onboard-pulse-site successfully creates site with CSV-imported equipment. Equipment count matches imported rows.
